text:
Sam W: Heads-up, posted a follow-up to the ingress lifecycle RFC — proposing an explicit "session-delegation" step so edge can hand off streaming ownership without duplicating state. https://r.redwood/rfcs/ingress-lifecycle
Anya P: quick q — does delegation mean we need to buffer the whole stream until downstream ack? that kills latency for short responses
Mike L: no, buffer not required. idea is to hand off a resumable token + minimal metadata (deadline, seq window). upstream keeps sending while edge switches ownership, but we need a short quorum for resume safety
Lina Z: memory/cost concern: if we allow many concurrent handoffs with inflight KV caches, GPUs will get hammered. we should bound concurrent delegations per-tenant
Sam W: agree with Lina. proposal includes a delegation budget per tenant + soft-fallback to non-resumable fast-path when budget exhausted
Anya P: what about side effects? if request causes a side-effect and we resume midstream we could duplicate. need idempotency hooks in API surface
Mike L: suggestion: require idempotency-key for any delegable call that can cause side effects. for others we provide a best-effort resume (may re-run last N tokens)
Sam W: we probably also want a retry semantics change: delegate step returns a short-lived resume_token and a retry_budget header that edge honors. example headers: `Resume-Token: <tkn>`, `Resume-Window: 64`, `Resume-Mode: strict|best-effort`
Anya P: can we see a minimal header + handshake example? makes it easier for SDKs
Mike L: sure, sketch:

```
POST /v1/generate
Headers:
  X-Client-Id: abc
  Idempotency-Key: 123
Response (edge -> client): 200 OK
  Resume-Token: r-xyz
  Stream-Ownership: edge

On handoff:
  Edge -> proxy: Handoff(Request-Id, Resume-Token, Resume-Window)
  New owner accepts and returns Ownership-Ack
```

Sam W: thanks. also thinking about observability: we should tag traces with `delegate_id` and emit a short handoff event so Console can reconstruct partial timelines
ops-bot: deploy-check: new handshake code touches gateway and edge-proxy, please add e2e that simulates a failing handoff and confirms fallback path
Lina Z: orchestration note — limit resume window sizes per model variant. larger windows = more KV memory. default to 64 tokens for Llama-like and 16 for shorter LMs
Anya P: UX question: what does SDK return to devs if we fallback to non-resumable? a clear error code or a degraded stream?
Mike L: SDK should expose a `resumable` boolean and emit an event `resume_unavailable` when fallback occurred. app can then decide to show a retry UI or fallback text
Sam W: decision candidates: (A) implement delegation + strict idempotency for side-effecting calls, bounded tenant delegation budget, resume token handshake, observability hooks. (B) keep current simpler model and accept higher tail latency on owner swaps. leaning A with conservative defaults
Lina Z: +1 for A if we enforce budget + per-model window caps. we should also add a garbage-collect step for orphaned resume tokens after TTL
Anya P: ok with A if SDK + docs are included in rollout plan
Mike L: I'll draft the follow-up PR with the handshake proto and a flag `edge.experimental.delegation` for gradual rollout
Sam W: action items: Mike - PR for proto + gateway changes; Lina - perf model for concurrent handoffs; Anya - SDK surface draft; ops-bot - add e2e test requirement to deploy checklist. I'll owner the RFC update. plan to land feature behind flag and run spike 2 weeks after flag release
Anya P: thanks — tagging infra team for quota advice : @infra-team
Sam W: cc @security for idempotency guidance and KMS implications for tokens
Mike L: small note: fallback path must be fast-path (no extra buffer) so client-visible latency stays bounded
Lina Z: will run rough sim and post numbers here when ready
ops-bot: reminder: add config toggle and rollout playbook before canary
Sam W: cool, thanks all. I'll update the RFC with decisions and attach the handshake sketch. :thumbsup:
